claim.text: Grouped-query attention lets several queries share one key and value, so the KV cache grows with the number of KV heads

spec.explain: Illustrative toy of arXiv 2305.13245: blocks show several query blocks sharing one key-value block, so the drawn cache grows only with KV heads. The limit kv_heads <= q_heads keeps sharing valid.

questions.q: Predict what kv_heads set to 4 will show before you move it?
Many think more queries need more cache: with q_heads at 32, what do you expect to see?
If kv_heads stays small while q_heads is 64, how is sharing shown?
With q_heads at 16 and kv_heads at 2, what grouping do you expect?

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var kv = state.kv_heads; var q = state.q_heads; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); var palette = ["#1f4b99", "#c4512c", "#2a7f62", "#8a5fc0", "#b5892e", "#3a9ad9", "#d46a9d", "#5a6b2d"]; var qx = 40; var qy = 62; var qw = 360; var qh = 124; var colsPerRow = 16; if (q <= 16) { colsPerRow = 8; } var rows = Math.ceil(q / colsPerRow); var cellW = qw / colsPerRow; var cellH = qh / rows; var i = 0; var c = 0; var r = 0; var g = 0; var bx = 0; var by = 0; for (i = 0; i < q; i++) { c = i - Math.floor(i / colsPerRow) * colsPerRow; r = Math.floor(i / colsPerRow); g = Math.floor(i * kv / q); bx = qx + c * cellW + 2; by = qy + r * cellH + 2; ctx.fillStyle = palette[g]; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, cellW - 4, cellH - 5); } var kx = 40; var ky = 222; var kw = 360; var slot = kw / kv; var j = 0; var cx = 0; var kxx = 0; for (j = 0; j < kv; j++) { cx = kx + j * slot; ctx.fillStyle = palette[j]; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.28; ctx.fillRect(cx + 1, qy - 8, slot - 2, qh + 16); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.fillStyle = palette[j]; ctx.fillRect(cx + 4, ky, slot / 2 - 6, 44); ctx.fillRect(cx + slot / 2 + 1, ky, slot / 2 - 6, 44); ctx.strokeStyle = "#222222"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(cx + 4, ky, slot / 2 - 6, 44); ctx.strokeRect(cx + slot / 2 + 1, ky, slot / 2 - 6, 44); ctx.fillStyle = "#222222"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("K", cx + 8, ky + 27); ctx.fillText("V", cx + slot / 2 + 5, ky + 27); } var qcx = 0; var qby = 0; var kcx = 0; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (i = 0; i < q; i++) { c = i - Math.floor(i / colsPerRow) * colsPerRow; r = Math.floor(i / colsPerRow); g = Math.floor(i * kv / q); bx = qx + c * cellW + 2; by = qy + r * cellH + 2; qcx = bx + (cellW - 4) / 2; qby = by + cellH - 5; kcx = kx + (g + 0.5) * slot; ctx.strokeStyle = palette[g]; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(qcx, qby); ctx.lineTo(kcx, ky); ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; } ctx.fillStyle = "#222222"; ctx.font = "14px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("queries", 40, 48); ctx.fillText("KV cache", 40, 210); ctx.fillText("cache_size = " + fmt(kv * 2), 440, 140); ctx.fillText("sharing_factor = " + fmt(q / kv), 440, 166); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("q_heads = " + fmt(q), 440, 192); ctx.fillText("kv_heads = " + fmt(kv), 440, 212); }
